authority_model.raw_source: Libya ATLAS Project.gdb + latest supplied institutional KML snapshots
authority_model.source_version_rule: Latest supplied snapshot replaces older same-source snapshot in active master; older copies are archive/provenance only.
authority_model.governance_baseline: Previously governed layers remain authoritative in their own governed layer and are never recreated as new authority.
authority_model.deduplication: Raw sources are immutable. Exact same-target duplicates are suppressed only in the master projection. Cross-layer overlaps remain relationships.
authority_model.production_authority: PostgreSQL/PostGIS only after separate review, approval and publication.

guardrails: WORLD_HERITAGE authority is exactly five parent sites: Cyrene/Shahat, Leptis Magna, Sabratha, Ghadames and Acacus.
Old Tripoli KML is reference/subfeature context because OLD_TRIPOLI is already governed.
Acacus detailed KML is subfeature context under the already governed ACACUS World Heritage parent; it is not hundreds of new World Heritage sites.
The World Heritage detailed KML contains five parent site references plus subfeatures; subfeatures do not create new World Heritage authority.
No polygon is treated as an authoritative heritage, park, development, archaeological or protected-area boundary without explicit reviewed semantics.
Raw source records are never deleted by deduplication.
